summary: A bare, valid audit invocation must produce a result or fail loudly; it must never degrade to printing its own help with exit 0.
reason: Six novel commands guarded on zero-args-zero-flags and returned Help(), so the most natural invocation silently did nothing while every flagged invocation worked. Commands needing an id now error non-zero instead.
validated_outcome: Regression test invokes each command truly bare (no flags, XDG redirected); confirmed to fail with the guard reintroduced and pass without it.
